scope: 137 new source-map traces + four corrected inherited Hiiumaa records + three added civilian localities. Shared period-label and visibility rules are in atlas-volume-one-corrections.json.

detailExpansion.sourceMaterial: Existing inspected U.S. Army Center of Military History operational plates and their preserved pixel-to-WGS84 affine registrations. No new geographic controls or source images are introduced by this pass.
detailExpansion.interpretation: The majority of additions are source-map command-sector labels, not headquarters coordinates, surveyed formation frontages, troop-strength estimates or complete orders of battle.
temporalRules: New formation labels from multi-date plates appear only when the source interval has ended. Their labels retain the full source interval, and later appearances remain earlier references.
New front fragments retain the exact printed source date. January 1 lines provide the comparison for the January 8 Rzhev view.
Attack and withdrawal arrows appear at the ending supported selection, never as interpolated day-by-day itineraries.
Selected later dates gain explicitly earlier source comparisons only; no earlier line is recast as current control.
detailExpansion.sourcePixelOverlayReview: All retained new direction/front traces were overlaid on the existing source plates. Ambiguous new railway/river alignments, four broad front lines and three Phase I direction traces were removed; three retained front fragments were shortened and retraced to clearly legible symbols.
detailExpansion.iskraJanuary18SourceGap: Defeat map 10 depicts the German front on 25 March 1943 and changes prior to that date; its only separately dated January sector says Lost 12–19 Jan43. It supports the existing generalized January19 zone, not a January18 front or January army positions. No future interval is relabeled as January18.
